metas.name: 2026 · Steps
metas.description: Blamed for magical mischief at the Royal Ball, stepsister Lilith turns her sister into a frog. She must work with Cinderella and a troll to save the kingdom and prove villains deserve happy endings too.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2026 · The Cat in the Hat
metas.description: Meet the Cat in the Hat you don't know in an all-new, epic adventure where mischief, magic and mayhem reign supreme.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2026 · Wildwood
metas.description: The adventures of Prue McKeel as she sets off to the forests outside Portland to find her kidnapped brother.

metas.name: 2026 · Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
metas.description: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2026 · Forgotten Island
metas.description: Two best friends become stranded on the mystical world of Nakali, where their only escape might cost them their shared lifetime of memories.
